author: Seung Wook
problem: A library book club met on day start and meets again every every days after that. Given a day today with today >= start, return how many days there are until the next meeting held on today or later.
bug_description: Uses every - (today - start) % every, without the check for a meeting falling on today itself, so that case gives every instead of 0.

comments.accurate: Days until the club's next meeting
comments.wrong_behavior: Days until the club's following meeting, counting forward from today
comments.wrong_location: Cycle arithmetic verified; check elapsed counts days from the first meeting
